note: Packet EARTHLOCK: the intake/replay race repair. The obligation on this pair is NOT that the block got smaller -- it is that EARTHRAM's measured M10K and its numbers SURVIVED a correctness repair. before=00b46669 (the packet's true parent, the integration merge), after=60bd7505 (the repair). Two -MapOnly leaf runs, both from a clean tree, SAME sourceListHash 79b44f51d810dc72 and same 378-file closure on both sides -- so this is a pair and not two measurements of different trees.

whatMoved.ram: UNCHANGED. `uni_we_c` neither moved nor gained a term, so the WRITE beat of the M10K is byte-identical. Only the READ enable `cap_en_c` gained `&& !entry_busy_c`. blockMemoryBits is 4880 on both sides and the inferred shape is the same 16 x 305 simple dual port EARTHRAM measured.
whatMoved.logic: +9 combinational ALUTs and +8 estimated ALMs, which is the per-entry interlock: one BankAw-wide equality (`lane_a == intake_a_c`), one 2:1 address mux and two AND terms. ZERO added registers -- the interlock is combinational over state that already existed, which is why `dedicatedRegisters` is identical.
whatMoved.notTaken: `no_rw_check` is now PROVABLY true on `b_uni` -- `entry_busy_c` makes the same-cycle same-address collision unreachable -- and is deliberately NOT declared. Taking it would change what the fitter may infer and would put a second, unrelated variable into this pair. It is an area question for a packet that can measure it alone.

categoriesKeptApart: ALUTs, registers, estimated ALMs, placed ALMs and block memory bits are five different numbers and are never summed. A MAP REPORTS NO BLOCK COUNT and no placed ALMs; those are fitter results and are recorded null rather than guessed.

capacityBound.note: the shipping target; a leaf map's utilisation is not a closure claim and these are recorded as the BOUND only

baselineCorrection.what: The first before-run was taken at 346d5b18 and DISCARDED. That commit is COMPOSEPUB's branch tip, not this packet's parent -- `git log -- <the adapter>` names it as the last commit to touch the FILE, which is not the same question as which commit this branch descends from. Its tree was missing fpga/rtl/common/zhao_fragment_state_pkg.sv (FRAGSTATE's, present in the merge) and its sourceListHash was 773ab0be0533f646 against the after-run's 79b44f51d810dc72.
baselineCorrection.why: A pair whose two sides have different closures measures the closure. The discarded run happened to return the identical 888/1093/1628/4880, and that agreement is NOT the reason it is fine to discard -- the reason the rows below are trustworthy is that their source-list hashes match. The tell was sourceFileCount 377 against 378.

portParity: virtualPins is 1617 on BOTH rows, which is the structural statement that this repair changed NO PORT. No `gen_prod_top.py` regeneration is owed and no committed `zhao_console_core` mutant copy is staled.
